berkshire-guard.summary: Berkshire Hathaway GUARD Insurance Companies write small business insurance through independent agents and brokers and are ultimately owned by Berkshire Hathaway Inc.

facts.text: GUARD says its companies are ultimately owned by Berkshire Hathaway Inc. and sell through a network of independent agents and brokers.
GUARD lists five subsidiary insurers: AmGUARD Insurance Company, AZGUARD Insurance Company, EastGUARD Insurance Company, NorGUARD Insurance Company and WestGUARD Insurance Company.
GUARD says it is headquartered in Wilkes-Barre, Pennsylvania, and was established in 1983.

GUARD's products are businessowner's policies, commercial auto, commercial umbrella, disability, general liability and inland marine, and workers' compensation. Availability varies by state; GUARD's operating area map shows each product's states.

links.label: GUARD Customer Center (policy service and contact)

steadily.summary: Steadily writes landlord insurance for owners of rental properties, from single-family homes to multi-family buildings and short-term rentals.

facts.text: Steadily writes landlord insurance for single-family, multi-family, accessory dwelling unit, condo unit, and vacant and restoration properties, and for short-term rentals.
The coverages Steadily lists include fire, water, storm and hail, legal liability, loss of rent, and vandalism and burglary.
Steadily says Steadily Insurance Company, an Arizona insurance company, and Steadily Insurance Agency, Inc. are fully owned subsidiaries of Steadily, Inc.
Steadily lists coverage in all 50 states, Kentucky included.
Steadily describes loss of rent coverage, also called fair rental value coverage, as replacing the rental income you lose when a covered event makes a rental uninhabitable.
Steadily says it writes liability coverage from $300,000 to $2 million into every landlord policy.

obie.summary: Obie offers landlord insurance for real estate investors and property managers, from single-family rentals to larger multifamily buildings.

facts.text: Obie offers landlord insurance for single-family homes, multifamily buildings of two to four units, buildings with five or more units, and condo units.
Obie describes its customers as landlords, real estate investors and property managers, and also works with lenders and technology partners.
Obie's site names Obie Insurance Group, LLC and Obie Insurance Services, LLC, with their license numbers.
Obie describes build-to-rent coverage for purpose-built rental homes and communities, addressing construction, property, liability, vacancy and rental income risks.
Obie publishes a Risk Map that shows local property risks.
Obie also offers embedded insurance, which lenders, platforms and real estate technology providers add to their own customer journeys through its APIs.

hartford.summary: The Hartford writes small business insurance, including business owner's policies, general liability, workers' compensation and commercial auto.

facts.text: The Hartford says it has supported and protected people and businesses for more than 200 years.
The Hartford's small business coverages include general liability, workers' compensation, professional liability, commercial property, commercial auto and cyber insurance.
The Hartford describes its business owner's policy as combining general liability, commercial property and business income insurance in one policy.
The Hartford says employment practices liability insurance may be added to its business owner's policy, for claims such as wrongful termination, discrimination and harassment.
The Hartford also offers insurance for midsize and large businesses and employee benefits for employers.

liberty-mutual.summary: Liberty Mutual writes personal and business insurance and sells through independent agents as well as its own channels.

facts.text: Liberty Mutual says independent agents sell its policies alongside policies from other insurance companies.

Liberty Mutual's business insurance solutions include general liability, property, commercial auto and fleet, workers compensation, umbrella and excess liability, cyber, professional liability and surety.
Liberty Mutual Insurance gives 175 Berkeley Street, Boston, Massachusetts as its address.
Ironshore, a Liberty Mutual company, offers specialty and excess and surplus insurance through the wholesale market for U.S. businesses with complex risks.
Liberty Mutual lists industry practices that include construction, manufacturing, real estate, professional services and public entities.
